subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should this issue stay in maintainer/live-repro review until a current-main Docker multi-agent heartbeat run proves the exact dropped-agent entry path?
rationale: The reporter supplied fresh release evidence, but current main has partial source and test coverage that should already route per-agent heartbeats; choosing between close, fix, or repair requires live proof of the remaining path.

options.title: Run live reproduction first
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a Docker/current-main multi-agent heartbeat proof before authorizing a new fix PR.

options.title: Authorize a narrow repair now
options.body: Allow a focused repair attempt based on the suspected cron target resolver path, accepting that it may miss the actual live entry point.

options.title: Close as covered by prior cron fix
options.body: Treat the shipped stale-runtime cron fix as sufficient despite the reporter's newer evidence, which risks closing an unresolved user workflow.

recommendation.title: Run live reproduction first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a Docker/current-main multi-agent heartbeat proof before authorizing a new fix PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the overlapping shipped fix and release interpretation through the merged cron PR and latest release tag.
